newsitem.title: TURKEY: TURKEY'S SISE CAM BELIEVES MAY AVOID STRIKE.
newsitem.headline: TURKEY'S SISE CAM BELIEVES MAY AVOID STRIKE.

text.p: Officials of Turkey's leading glass and glassware producer Turkiye Sise Cam Fabrikalari A.S. said negotiations may produce an accord despite a trade union strike decision.
"This is an ongoing process and a strike decision does not mean that it will happen," Rusdu Bozkurt, secretary general of the company, told Reuters.
"We still have 60 days more to negotiate and the possibility of an agreement has not faded completely," Bozkurt added.
An official from the workers' union Kristal-Is said the strike decision was a formal move.
"According to the collective bargaining process, we have come to the final stage and decided to go on strike," Mustafa Bahceci, chairman of Kristal Is, told Reuters.
"But we have not taken yet the decision to exercise it. Taking a strike decision does not mean that we will start the action soon," he added.
